notes: Read the line-numbered source before editing; every one of the 394 source lines was considered. Header doc comment (L1-4) ported and expanded for native to enumerate the browser-only dependency reductions. Imports (L5-13): react hooks kept but narrowed to the ones still used (useState/useMemo/useCallback) — useRef/useEffect (L5) existed only for the SignalMultiSelect DOM click-outside listener and are intentionally dropped; useQuery (L6) kept from '@tanstack/react-query'; request (L8) imported from '../api/client'; react-i18next useTranslation (L7) replaced by a native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, fallback?, params?) that interpolates i18next-style {{label}} placeholders (preserves every key + i18n intent); '@/components/ui' GlassPanel/Badge/Button/Input/DataTable/Column (L9) — GlassPanel imported from the native '../../components/ui/GlassPanel', the other four + the Column type reproduced locally as native-safe primitives; fmtInt (L10) + TIME_RANGE_PRESETS/matchTimeRangePreset (L11) ported locally; cn (L12) dropped in favour of StyleSheet + tokens; lucide-react icons (L13: Search/X/Play/ChevronLeft/ChevronRight/ChevronsLeft/ChevronsRight) rendered as decorative AppText glyphs via the local ICON map (\u2315 / \u00D7 / \u25B6 / \u2039 / \u203A / \u00AB / \u00BB).

SignalLogEntry interface (L16-24) preserved verbatim (created_at/signal/value_num?/value_str?/value_bool?). BE->FE adapter comment block (L26-34) preserved; the SignalHistoryPoint/SignalHistoryResp type import (L35) re-pointed to the native '../api/types' (which carries the same shapes). adaptSignalHistoryPoint (L37-63) ported verbatim including the typeof switch (number -> finite-guarded value_num, boolean -> value_bool, string -> value_str with the ValueKindTime/ValueKindString comment, default -> all nulled). adaptSignalHistoryResp (L65-69) ported verbatim incl. the Array.isArray guard + resp.signal ?? '' fallback. SignalHistoryPagination (L71-76) and SignalHistoryResponse (L78-81) interfaces preserved verbatim.

Shared helpers ported verbatim: toLocalDatetimeStr (L85-88) — same pad()+template producing YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; formatTimestampMs (L90-96) — same isNaN guard returning '—', same pad2/pad3 millis template; getValueType (L98-103) — same num/str/bool/null precedence; formatValue (L105-110) — same String(num)/str/bool->'true'|'false'/'—' branches. Only Prettier brace/line-wrap formatting differs; logic + the inline comments are identical. Verified by unit tests (adaptSignalHistoryPoint/Resp, toLocalDatetimeStr, formatTimestampMs, getValueType, formatValue).

Constants: TYPE_BADGE_COLOR (L112-114) preserved verbatim ({num:'cyan',str:'green',bool:'amber',null:'neutral'}) and consumed by the local Badge. TYPE_VALUE_COLOR (L116-120) — the web values were Tailwind class strings (text-cyan-300/text-emerald-300/text-amber-300/text-[var(--text-muted)]); native cannot apply Tailwind, so the toned-down 300-shade intent is preserved by mapping to the literal hexes #67e8f9 (cyan-300) / #6ee7b7 (emerald-300) / #fcd34d (amber-300) and colors.textMuted, and these colour values are applied directly in the Value cell. The Record<string,string> export shape is unchanged. PAGE_SIZES (L122) preserved verbatim ([25,50,100]).

Local native-safe ports of the consumed lib helpers: TIME_RANGE_PRESETS + matchTimeRangePreset (from ../lib/constants) ported verbatim (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d, the +/-60s tolerance span matcher) — also re-exported so screen consumers keep parity. fmtInt (from ../lib/numberFormat) ported as a self-contained integer formatter (safeNumber + toLocaleString with 0 fraction digits and an en-US fallback); the web global precision/locale singletons are not needed because fmtInt is always 0-decimal and uses the device locale (documented).

SignalMultiSelect (L124-219): props (vehicleId/selected/onChange/maxSignals) preserved. search/open useState (L134-135) preserved; the web ref (HTMLDivElement, L136) is dropped. useQuery (L138-142) preserved EXACTLY — queryKey ['signal-available', vehicleId], queryFn () => request<string[]>(`/signals/available?vehicle_id=${vehicleId}`) (web API path preserved verbatim, snake_case query param), staleTime 60_000. filtered memo (L144-149), addSignal (L151-155, incl. the maxSignals cap + setSearch('')) and removeSignal (L157-159) ported verbatim. The document mousedown click-outside effect (L161-167) is DOM-only and dropped; the dropdown instead closes on option select (the web primary close path) — documented. Render (L169-218): label 'Signals'+(max N) (L171-173) -> AppText (literal strings kept; the web source has NO i18n here, so faithful parity keeps them un-translated). Selected chips (L175-186) -> a flex-wrap chip row, each chip an AppText + a Pressable remove button (accessibilityLabel `Remove ${sig}`, glyph \u00D7, testID signal-chip-remove-${sig}). The Input (L188-196) -> local InputField (RN TextInput) with the search glyph icon, onChangeText (setSearch+setOpen true), onFocus (setOpen true), and the same 'Add more signals…' / 'Search signals…' placeholder. The absolute dropdown (L197-215) -> an inline View+ScrollView (maxHeight 240, keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled') gated on open && filtered.length>0, rendering filtered.slice(0,50) Pressable options (testID signal-option-${sig}, onPress add+close) and the 'N more — refine search' note when filtered.length>50 (the web absolute overlay becomes an inline expansion — documented).

DateTimeRangeControls (L221-272): props preserved. useTranslation -> useNativeTranslationFallback; activePresetHours = matchTimeRangePreset(fromStr,toStr) (L233) preserved. The web <input type='datetime-local' step='1'> From/To fields (L240, L244) have no native control and no date-picker dependency is installed, so they become native-safe TextInputs (value=fromStr/toStr, onChangeText=onFromChange/onToChange, placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss', autoCapitalize/autoCorrect off) accepting the same local datetime string the web emitted — fromStr/toStr/onFromChange/onToChange and the second precision intent are preserved (documented). t keys preserved: signalQuery.from 'From', signalQuery.to 'To', signalQuery.quickRange 'Quick Range'. The TIME_RANGE_PRESETS.map preset chips (L249-267) -> Pressable chips: active highlight via matchTimeRangePreset, aria-pressed -> accessibilityState={{selected: active}}, aria-label -> accessibilityLabel t('signalQuery.preset.aria','{{label}} time range',{label}), onClick -> onPress(tp.hours), testID signal-preset-${label}. Verified by the DateTimeRangeControls test (field edits, preset press, active-chip selection).

QueryControls (L274-306): props preserved. buttonLabel = label ?? t('signalQuery.query','Query') (L287) preserved. The Rows label t('signalQuery.rows','Rows') (L291) preserved. The web <select> over PAGE_SIZES (L292-298) -> a segmented row of Pressable chips (one per PAGE_SIZE, active=perPage, onPress=onPerPageChange(Number(s)), testID signal-perpage-${s}) — the native analog of a value picker (documented). The web Button variant='primary' size='sm' with the Play icon + loading + disabled (L300-303) -> the local native-safe Button (primary, height 34, ActivityIndicator while loading, Play glyph \u25B6 otherwise, accessibilityState disabled/busy, testID signal-query-button). Verified by the QueryControls tests (page-size change, query press, disabled state).

SignalDataTable (L308-394): props preserved. Loading branch (L321-323) -> a GlassPanel (testID signal-data-table-loading) with 5 skeleton bars (the web animate-pulse is rendered as static muted bars; no animation primitive used — documented). IndexedEntry type + indexedRows _rowNum computation (L325-329) preserved verbatim ((page-1)*perPage+i+1). The Column<IndexedEntry>[] array (L331-367) preserved 1:1 with the same 5 columns (index '#', created_at 'Timestamp', signal 'Signal', value 'Value', type 'Type') and the same render fns; the web per-column className (font-mono + text colour) is carried by the native Column.cellStyle analog (cellIndex muted-mono, cellTimestamp secondary-mono, cellSignal primary-mono) — the Value cell returns a mono AppText coloured by TYPE_VALUE_COLOR[getValueType] and the Type cell returns <Badge color={TYPE_BADGE_COLOR[vt]}>{vt}</Badge>, exactly as the web spans. The GlassPanel + DataTable usage (L369-377: columns/data/keyExtractor=row._rowNum/emptyMessage='No results'/compact) is reproduced by the local generic DataTable (header row + body rows over View/AppText, empty-state, compact padding). Pagination footer (L379-391) gated on totalPages>1 -> a row with `${fmtInt(total)} records` and the 4 nav Pressables (first/prev/next/last) with the same disabled rules (page<=1 / page>=totalPages), the same chevron glyphs (\u00AB \u2039 \u203A \u00BB), and 'Page {page} of {totalPages}'; testIDs signal-page-first/prev/next/last. Verified by the SignalDataTable tests (loading, empty, rows, multi-page navigation).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web @/components/ui imports are present in the native output — only React, react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View + Style types), '@tanstack/react-query' useQuery, the native AppText + GlassPanel, theme tokens (colors/spacing), the native '../api/client' request, and the native '../api/types' SignalHistoryPoint/SignalHistoryResp. font-mono is mapped via Platform.select (Menlo/monospace). Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npm run lint -- --quiet exit 0; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles -> 23 suites / 136 tests passed (incl. the new 17-test __tests__/SignalQueryControls.test.tsx).
